digest.component_or_area: per-class LLM fallback model construction in rebar/llm
propositions: A single unreachable model in a class fails the gate outright with no way to fall back to an alternate hosted or local model.
A class with a fallback list should build a pydantic-ai FallbackModel whose default is the primary entry, while a class without fallbacks builds an unwrapped model unchanged.

The fallback_on predicate must be derived from failure.py's _RETRYABLE frozenset plus CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL, firing on transport errors, 429/529/5xx but not on 401/403, 400 context-length, or a 429 carrying insufficient_quota.
Fallback entries are inline model configs whose endpoint must be honored so a local OpenAI-compatible proxy is actually built against that endpoint.
Capabilities must be the conservative intersection over all resolved candidate model objects computed before the wrapper is built, since FallbackModel has no profile and returns None provider.

provider_provenance must record ordered candidates and a ran_model read from the returned ModelResponse.model_name so a fallback verdict does not misattribute the primary, and the FallbackModel must be used as an async context manager with rebar-owned clients closed exactly once.
